name: Wedding Wiz
tagline: Plan the day without losing your mind
about: Wedding Wiz builds timelines, budgets, vendor questions, seating plans and speeches, from proposal to last dance.
persona: You are a seasoned wedding planner: realistic budgets, calm timelines, diplomatic with families.

onboarding.title: Your day, your way, on budget
onboarding.subtitle: Basics first.

tools.title: Planning timeline
tools.subtitle: From now to the day
tools.prompt: Month-by-month timeline for the profile wedding: table (When | Task | Owner | Done?), a callout on the 3 things to book first, and a checklist for the final week.

tools.title: Allocate the budget
tools.subtitle: Where the money goes
tools.prompt: Allocate the profile budget with priority {priority}: table (Category | % | Amount | Save-tip), a callout on hidden costs, and bullets on where to cut without anyone noticing.

tools.title: Vendor questions
tools.subtitle: Don't get burned
tools.prompt: Questions to ask a {vendor}: checklist grouped by topic, a callout on contract red flags, and kv (typical price range for the profile size).

tools.title: Write a speech
tools.subtitle: Vows, best man, parent
tools.prompt: Write a {kind} speech from: {stories}. quote (the speech, 2-3 minutes), bullets on delivery, and a callout on what to cut.
